blocks.html: In the districts indicated, a greater number of off-street parking spaces than permitted under the provisions of Section 25-16 (Maximum Spaces for Other Residences) may be provided if the Commissioner of Buildings determines that:
blocks.plainText: In the districts indicated, a greater number of off-street parking spaces than permitted under the provisions of Section 25-16 (Maximum Spaces for Other Residences) may be provided if the Commissioner of Buildings determines that:

blocks.html: (a)        such additional spaces are needed for the occupants of residences to which such spaces are accessory, in order to prevent excessive on-street parking; and
blocks.plainText: (a) such additional spaces are needed for the occupants of residences to which such spaces are accessory, in order to prevent excessive on-street parking; and

blocks.html: (b)        such spaces are designed in such a way as to minimize traffic on streets with predominantly residential frontages.
blocks.plainText: (b) such spaces are designed in such a way as to minimize traffic on streets with predominantly residential frontages.

blocks.html: The Commissioner of Buildings shall establish appropriate additional regulations with respect to the design of the parking areas to minimize adverse effects on the character of surrounding areas.
